name: Wild Shore
summary: Bloodsail Buccaneers anchor along Wild Shore, where Stranglethorn Vale's jungle meets the South Seas.

sections.title: Edge of the South Seas
sections.body: At Stranglethorn Vale's southern tip, you reach the Wild Shore and the South Seas. Booty Bay's fortified inlet lies northwest, while a shallow strait separates the mainland beach from Jaguero Isle to the east. The shore runs northeast toward the Crystal Shore. Blackwater Raiders' cannons cannot reach this coast directly, so pirates gather here among wild dangers.

sections.title: Pirates and Giants
sections.body:
Bloodsail Buccaneers hold much of the shore. Their wooden ships anchor in the surf, and their camps spread across the sand. They stage operations here, store illicit cargo, and plan strikes against their goblin rivals.

Prowling beasts also haunt the beaches. Gorlash, a colossal sea giant, stomps through the surf and crushes anyone who lingers along the tide line.

faq.q: Where is the Wild Shore located?
faq.answer: Wild Shore forms Stranglethorn Vale's southern coastline in the Eastern Kingdoms. South of Booty Bay, it faces the South Seas and Jaguero Isle.

aliases: who lives on the wild shore
faq.answer: Bloodsail Buccaneers dominate the coastline. They moor several ships in the shallows and keep camps along the sandy beaches.

aliases: who is the giant on the beach
faq.answer: Gorlash is an enormous sea giant who prowls Wild Shore's shallows. He threatens unwary sailors and pirates walking the beach.

faq.q: How does the Wild Shore relate to Booty Bay?
faq.answer: A rocky point separates Booty Bay from Wild Shore. Booty Bay is the stronghold of the Blackwater Raiders and the Steamwheedle Cartel. Nearby, Wild Shore gives their sworn enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers, a natural staging ground.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can pick pockets in Bloodsail camps and aboard anchored vessels. You can also study rival swashbucklers operating beyond the Steamwheedle Cartel's law.
